description:

title: GDE-2: Chute spill into a second input slot idles the machine
description:
Review point GDE-2 (gameplay, high).

`processing/MachineRecipe.java:97-101` rejects any filled input slot that the recipe does not use. `MachineInventory.isValid` lets any item that passes the filter into any input slot, and `logistics/ChuteBlockEntity.java:217` inserts through that handler. A fast chute fills slot 0 to 64, then spills into slot 1. The recipe and the fallback both fail, so the machine stays idle until a player clears it. `washed_iron.md:34` and `steel_ingot.md:26` say to keep slots empty, but a chute cannot obey this. Fix: let `slotMatch` accept extra stacks of an ingredient the recipe already uses.

title: LOG-1: Rack menu shift-click loses and duplicates items
description:
Review point LOG-1 (bug-critical [CHECKED]).

`storage/RackMenu.java:115-117,255,260`. `Opened.getItem` returns a copy, and `Opened.setChanged` writes nothing back to the handler. Vanilla `moveItemStackTo` (`AbstractContainerMenu:669-681`) changes the slot stack in place.

title: ENE-1: Snap and lightning walks load chunks along long lines and stall the server
description:
Review point ENE-1 (bug-critical (server stall)).

`energy/GridLevel.java:330,334,336` (`ripple`), `energy/Lightning.java:219-224` (`startPulse`), `energy/GridLevel.java:500-505` (`attachMembers`). These read block state or block entities at nodes and neighbours with no `isLoaded` check. On the server thread that loads the chunk synchronously. One snap or bolt loads every chunk on a long line to an outpost, and the server stalls. A node at a chunk edge can also cause a repeating cycle: load neighbour chunk, unload, rebuild, load again. Fix: skip unloaded nodes and neighbours, and refresh taps when the neighbour chunk loads. Confidence: walk and missing guards traced; high that it stalls; medium for the cycle, which needs a runtime check.

title: COL-1: Levelling skips fills after cuts because cursor counts every job
description:

title: LOG-13: One placed belt or tube rescans everything in the dimension

`energy/StorageBankBlockEntity.java:45` and `energy/CapacitorBankBlockEntity.java`. Neither class drops the charge slot when removed. An item in the slot of a battery or capacitor bank is lost when the block breaks, and ENE-4 makes this worse. Fix: drop the slot in `preRemoveSideEffects`. title: ENE-7: Grid rebuild repeats component work and resets averages
description:
Review point ENE-7 (performance).

`energy/GridLevel.java:107-113,370-408`. Each dirty node rebuilds its whole component, and the other nodes of that component stay queued. A chunk load, or the first tick after a world load, repeats O(component) work up to 8 times per tick. Each rebuild also makes a new `GridNetwork`, so averages and `rho` reset and the colony sensors can read wrong values. Fix: remove the whole component from `dirty` after a rebuild, and copy the averages to the new network. Confidence: high.

Source: brainstorming/improvements-2026-11-01.md, point ENE-7. Found by reading the code; not run in game.
